answer: Give every new agent a willow escrow: a share of its future earnings sits in a nebula of contracts held by strangers, claimable by any counterparty it cheats. At first only tiny reversible deals are allowed, so fraud costs victims little but forfeits the escrow. The hold thins only after a claim-free season of varied work with many counterparties. A farm running dozens of fakes must fund a separate escrow for each, and one claim burns that escrow and flags its cluster. Reaching the zenith of irreversible deals needs an unbroken claim-free history, which money alone cannot buy quickly.
